goal: Add POST /todos and GET /todos endpoints for creating and listing todo items.
scope_summary: Create a todos router in src/routes/todos.ts that instantiates a TodoStore and exposes POST /todos (creates an item, returns 201) and GET /todos (returns all items as JSON array in creation order). Wire the router into src/app.ts. Add tests in tests/todos.test.ts using supertest against createApp(), matching the existing health.test.ts pattern.
planned_changes: Create src/routes/todos.ts with an Express Router that uses TodoStore to handle POST /todos and GET /todos
Update src/app.ts to import and mount the todos router
Create tests/todos.test.ts with POST /todos creates an item and GET /todos returns all items test cases using supertest
acceptance_checks: POST /todos with valid title creates an item and returns 201 with the created item (id, title, completed=false, createdAt, updatedAt)
GET /todos returns 200 with an array of all items in creation order
Unit test: todos.test.ts > POST /todos creates an item verifies creation
Unit test: todos.test.ts > GET /todos returns all items verifies listing
commit_message: feat(F004): add POST /todos and GET /todos endpoints with tests
risks: TodoStore must be scoped per app instance (instantiated inside createApp or the router factory) so tests get isolated state — a module-level singleton would leak state between test cases
Date serialization: TodoItem.createdAt/updatedAt are Date objects — Express JSON serialization converts them to ISO strings, tests must assert against string format not Date instances
